journey.name: Connect YouCam credentials
journey.description: Opens Settings and reaches the YouCam try-on credentials sheet, verifying the client id and client secret fields and the save action. Start state: fresh install with no YouCam credentials configured. Stops before entering real credentials.

actions.action: Tap the "SETTINGS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Settings screen shows a "YouCam Try-On" row with the subtitle "Required for virtual try-on".
Verify the YouCam credentials sheet is shown with a "Client ID" field (youcam_client_id_field), a "Client secret" field (youcam_client_secret_field), and a "Save credentials" button.
Verify the "Save credentials" button is disabled while both fields are empty.
